readout_other: LFP/EMG sleep staging, SO-spindle coupling, theta-gamma PAC; Y-maze novelty preference; fear conditioning and extinction
direction_notes: NREM SO up-state stimulation reduced SO and spindle activity and impaired spatial memory (and facilitated fear extinction); REM theta-peak stimulation enhanced theta power and theta-gamma coupling and improved spatial memory in healthy and AD mice.
safety_notes: Theoretical temperature rise stated as <0.5 C from the bio-heat equation; no adverse-event assessment reported.

exposures.label: Closed-loop TUS, motor cortex (NREM SO up-state; also pre-sleep)

timing.protocol_description: Closed-loop: a 50 ms pulse triggered at each detected SO up-state (NREM) or theta peak (REM, 1 Hz scan), for 1 h from the first stimulus within a 2 h window, daily for seven consecutive days. Pre-sleep comparison group (motor cortex) received 15 min daily before an 8 h sleep recording.

Closed-loop: a 50 ms pulse triggered at each detected SO up-state (NREM) or theta peak (REM, 1 Hz scan), for 1 h from the first stimulus within a 2 h window, daily for seven consecutive days. Pre-sleep comparison group (motor cortex) received 15 min daily before an 8 h sleep recording.

flags.reason: 60 is the sum of the two enrolled strains (48 + 12), including sham and pre-sleep animals; number actually exposed to ultrasound not stated (figure legends give n = 6 per group).
Hydrophone-measured values; the paper does not say whether water or through skull, so placed in unspecified_domain. Same values given for both targets.
Stimulation is a triggered 50 ms pulse at each event; 3600 s is the 1 h delivery period from the first stimulus, not a continuous train.
Text says 'stimulation duration of 50 ms' and elsewhere 'pulse duration (50 ms)'; taken as pulse duration.
One exposure per target; motor cortex entry also covers the pre-sleep stimulation group with the same parameters.
